title: Clear Thinking
author: Shane Parrish
engineRationale: Clear Thinking is about the invisible moment between stimulus and response in ordinary daily decisions (an angry email, a restaurant choice, a default reaction) — abstract/internal cognitive machinery with an everyman protagonist and no specific real people to depict. Flat-vector rigged Everyman + kinetic typography (Antidote) portrays 'the pause before you react' far better and cheaper than photoreal cut-outs.
